_note: Studio art direction per trek (proposal, editable). Taglines and regions are quoted from the old home page (https://bhutantrekkings.com/), not written by the studio.

bumdra-trek.tagline: A short cliff-camp trek above Paro, ending at the Tiger's Nest

druk-path-trek.tagline: Bhutan's classic lake-and-ridge trek between Paro and Thimphu

dagala-thousand-lakes-trek.tagline: High meadows and a scatter of alpine lakes south of Thimphu

jomolhari-round-trek.tagline: The Dodhina route — the full Jomolhari circuit over two high passes

soi-yaksa-trek.tagline: A wild Jomolhari-region loop over the Bonte La

laya-lingzhi-trek.tagline: Deep into the far north to the village of the Layap people

snowman-trek.tagline: The full Paro-to-Bumthang traverse — one of the hardest treks on earth

snowman-trek-ii.tagline: The full western approach, then south through Lunana to the Nikachhu

snowman-trek-iii.tagline: Lunana and the Gangkhar Puensum base camp, finishing in Bumthang

snowman-trek-iv.tagline: The shortest way into Lunana, starting from Laya
